description: Two possible protests appear only in Africa Press search-result titles (unemployed doctors in Kitwe/Lusaka; displaced traders/transport workers over trading-area sale). A saved actual HTTP 403 for another story on the same publisher domain barred bodies and copies; neither lead's origin is verified.
required_followup: Seek genuinely independent contemporaneous sources with distinct reporting origins and bylines; do not retrieve either Africa Press page or copies of their written origin.

description: No physical date or original publication date is present in the captured headline; the broad query's date terms do not prove the story occurred in that week or month.
required_followup: Find a permitted independent source that states the publication date and physical action date; otherwise keep date unknown and month ownership pending.

description: No attendance appears in the search-only headline. The 50-person threshold is unresolved; an employed or unemployed workforce total would not measure attendees.
required_followup: Find an independent event-day account or organizer record with an attendee estimate and public-access details.

description: The search title names unemployed doctors but gives no demand or target; conflict with a private employer alone would not establish a demand to Zambia's own state.
required_followup: Find independent reporting that states the demands and whether they addressed domestic government policy or action.

description: A title naming Kitwe and Lusaka does not establish a single coordinated event, separate city actions, continuity, or ownership month.
required_followup: Compare permitted independent contemporaneous reports across the two cities and adjacent months; do not merge without evidence of organization and physical continuity.

description: The displaced-traders headline has no event or publication date. Its appearance in a late-January search does not establish January physical onset or ownership.
required_followup: Find a permitted independent contemporaneous source giving both publication and physical action dates; otherwise keep date and ownership unresolved.

description: The headline number refers to displaced traders and transport workers, not necessarily people present at a protest; the 50-person threshold is unknown.
required_followup: Seek an independent event-day attendance estimate and public-access description; do not use affected population or workforce as turnout.

description: The title does not identify who sold the trading area or what demand protesters made. The dispute may involve a private actor; no domestic state target is established.
required_followup: Find a permitted independent account specifying the seller, governing decision, demands, and addressee.

description: The title does not identify a location or whether displaced traders and bus/taxi drivers formed one coordinated public gathering or separate actions.
required_followup: Seek independent reporting by location, organizer, and date; resolve event unit and physical continuity before assigning January ownership.

description: Africa Press may republish local reporting; the original byline and written origin are unknown for E002 and E001. These search hits are not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Compare search-only headlines with permitted independent bylined reports; record writer, agency, statement and body-copy relationships separately.
